config:
{
  "default_cwd": "C:/ezagent",
  "llm_pinned": true,
  "llm_provider": "opencode",
  "llm_model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash",
  "llm_base_url": "https://opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1",
  "llm_api_style": "openai",
  "hotkey": "ctrl+alt+space",
  "cancel_hotkey": "ctrl+alt+e",
  "repeat_hotkey": "ctrl+alt+r",
  "mute_hotkey": "ctrl+alt+m",
  "menu_hotkey": "ctrl+alt+o",
  "chat_hotkey": "ctrl+alt+t",
  "chat_voice": false,
  "whisper_url": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/inference",
  "auto_start_whisper": true,
  "stt_model": "ggml-large-v3-turbo-q8_0",
  "stt_engine": "auto",
  "whisper_home": "",
  "stt_prompt": "",
  "stt_dictionary": "",
  "stt_vocabulary_hints": true,
  "stt_beam_size": 5,
  "stt_timeout_secs": 10.0,
  "voice": "em_alex",
  "speed": 0.95,
  "tts_model_variant": "int8",
  "kokoro_model_path": "",
  "kokoro_voices_path": "",
  "tts_sentence_pause": 0.3,
  "tts_clause_pause": 0.12,
  "input_device_index": null,
  "output_device_index": null,
  "silence_secs": 1.3,
  "min_rms": 0.0006,
  "pre_roll_secs": 0.6,
  "min_speech_secs": 0.2,
  "max_utterance_secs": 30.0,
  "noise_multiplier": 1.3,
  "barge_in": true,
  "barge_in_rms": 0.008,
  "barge_in_secs": 0.25,
  "smart_turn": true,
  "turn_quick_secs": 0.35,
  "turn_threshold": 0.5,
  "vad_defaults_version": 2,
  "defaults_version": 2,
  "llm_profile_name": "",
  "llm_saved_profile": "",
  "api_key": "",
  "llm_temperature": 0.3,
  "llm_max_tokens": 320,
  "llm_context_tokens": 32000,
  "llm_reasoning_effort": "none",
  "llm_timeout_secs": 30.0,
  "llm_turn_timeout_secs": 120.0,
  "llm_max_tool_rounds": 8,
  "confirm_actions": false,
  "hc_path": "hc",
  "herdr_app_path": "herdr-app",
  "agents": {
    "claude": [
      "claude"
    ],
    "opencode": [
      "opencode"
    ],
    "mcode": [
      "mcode"
    ],
    "minimax": [
      "mcode"
    ],
    "codex": [
      "codex"
    ],
    "pi": [
      "pi"
    ],
    "qwen": [
      "qwen"
    ]
  },
  "agent_profiles": {
    "claude": {
      "label": "Claude Code",
      "aliases": [
        "claude code",
        "cloud code",
        "clod code",
        "clode"
      ],
      "models": [
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "efforts": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ],
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [
        "--model",
        "{model}"
      ],
      "effort_args": [
        "--effort",
        "{effort}"
      ],
      "swarm_args": [
        "--allowedTools",
        "Bash(ezs *)"
      ],
      "session_commands": {
        "model": [
          {
            "send": "/model {model}",
            "soft": true
          }
        ],
        "effort": [
          {
            "send": "/effort {effort}",
            "soft": true
          }
        ]
      },
      "notes": "Modelos por alias (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku). Admite plan mode y subagentes propios; bueno para planificar y auditar."
    },
    "opencode": {
      "label": "OpenCode",
      "aliases": [
        "open code",
        "open-code",
        "opencoder",
        "opencod"
      ],
      "models": [
        "deepseek-v4.1-flash",
        "deepseek-v4-pro",
        "glm-5.3",
        "kimi-k3",
        "minimax-m3.1-flash",
        "claude-haiku-5-5"
      ],
      "efforts": [],
      "model_efforts": {
        "deepseek-v4.1-flash": [
          "low",
          "high",
          "max"
        ],
        "deepseek-v4-pro": [
          "high",
          "max"
        ],
        "glm-5.3": [
          "low",
          "high",
          "max"
        ],
        "kimi-k3": [
          "max"
        ],
        "minimax-m3.1-flash": [
          "low",
          "medium",
          "high",
          "xhigh",
          "max"
        ],
        "claude-haiku-5-5": [
          "none",
          "low",
          "medium",
          "high",
          "xhigh",
          "max"
        ]
      },
      "prelaunch": "opencode_state",
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [],
      "effort_args": [],
      "model_prefix": "opencode-go/",
      "env": {
        "OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT": "{\"model\":\"{model_ref}{variant}\"}"
      },
      "env_args": [
        "--standalone"
      ],
      "session_commands": {
        "model": [
          {
            "send": "/models",
            "expect": "Select model",
            "message": "no se abrió el selector de modelos"
          },
          {
            "send": "{model_search}",
            "expect": "Switched model to",
            "message": "OpenCode no encontró el modelo {model}"
          }
        ],
        "effort": [
          {
            "send": "/effort",
            "expect": "Select variant",
            "fail": "No variants available|does not support any variants",
            "message": "el modelo actual de OpenCode no tiene niveles de esfuerzo",
            "optional": true
          },
          {
            "keys": [
              "esc"
            ]
          },
          {
            "cycle": {
              "keys": [
                "ctrl+t"
              ],
              "until": "Switched variant to {effort}",
              "max": 8
            },
            "message": "OpenCode no tiene el nivel {effort} para este modelo",
            "optional": true
          }
        ]
      },
      "notes": "Modelo y esfuerzo se fijan al lanzar (proveedor/modelo#nivel, p. ej. opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high); el nivel debe existir en ese modelo. action=guide trae el manual."
    },
    "mcode": {
      "label": "MiniMax Code",
      "aliases": [
        "m code",
        "minimax code",
        "mini max code",
        "emcode"
      ],
      "models": [],
      "efforts": [
        "default",
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ],
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [
        "--model",
        "{model}"
      ],
      "effort_args": [],
      "prelaunch": "mcode_effort",
      "discover": "mcode",
      "session_commands": {},
      "notes": "Modelo como proveedor/modelo (se resuelve contra su config); el esfuerzo se escribe en su config.yaml antes de abrir y queda como su valor por defecto. action=guide trae el manual."
    },
    "minimax": {
      "label": "MiniMax (mcode)",
      "aliases": [
        "mini max"
      ],
      "models": [],
      "efforts": [
        "default",
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ],
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [
        "--model",
        "{model}"
      ],
      "effort_args": [],
      "prelaunch": "mcode_effort",
      "discover": "mcode",
      "session_commands": {},
      "notes": "Alias de mcode."
    },
    "codex": {
      "label": "Codex",
      "aliases": [
        "codex cli",
        "kodex",
        "codecs",
        "códex"
      ],
      "models": [],
      "efforts": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "ultra"
      ],
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [
        "--model",
        "{model}"
      ],
      "effort_args": [
        "-c",
        "model_reasoning_effort={effort}"
      ],
      "swarm_args": [
        "--yolo"
      ],
      "discover": "codex",
      "session_commands": {},
      "notes": "Modelo y esfuerzo se fijan al lanzar; dentro de la sesión /model abre un selector que no se puede dictar."
    },
    "qwen": {
      "label": "Qwen Code",
      "aliases": [
        "qwen code",
        "quen code",
        "qwen coder",
        "cuen"
      ],
      "models": [
        "qwen3-coder-plus"
      ],
      "efforts": [],
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [
        "--model",
        "{model}"
      ],
      "effort_args": [],
      "session_commands": {},
      "notes": "El modelo se fija al lanzar con --model; no tiene flag de esfuerzo. action=guide trae el manual."
    },
    "pi": {
      "label": "Pi",
      "aliases": [
        "pi agent",
        "pi coding agent",
        "pie"
      ],
      "models": [],
      "efforts": [
        "off",
        "minimal",
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ],
      "default_model": "",
      "default_effort": "",
      "model_args": [
        "--model",
        "{model}"
      ],
      "effort_args": [
        "--thinking",
        "{effort}"
      ],
      "session_commands": {},
      "notes": "Modelo como proveedor/id (admite sufijo :nivel de razonamiento). El esfuerzo es el nivel de thinking."
    }
  },
  "agent_profiles_version": 8,
  "announce_all": false,
  "max_read_lines": 40,
  "hud_hidden": false,
  "drop_x": null,
  "drop_y": null,
  "drop_layout": "",
  "drop_dock": "",
  "chat_width": 0.0,
  "chat_height": 0.0,
  "ui_layout": "pill",
  "ui_motion": "system",
  "ui_scale": 1.0,
  "show_advanced": false,
  "settings_x": null,
  "settings_y": null,
  "settings_w": null,
  "settings_h": null,
  "close_action": "pause",
  "voice_wake": true,
  "wake_phrase": "EzAgent, escúchame",
  "theme": "auto",
  "theme_base": "dark",
  "theme_primary": "#1FAE9F",
  "theme_secondary": "#8FE3C0",
  "theme_accent": "#FF8A65",
  "theme_background": "#0E6F7C"
}
